mechanism: Hydrocortisone may increase hepatic metabolism of pyrazinamide and reduce its efficacy, while pyrazinamide can inhibit cortisol metabolism and increase hydrocortisone levels; corticosteroids also impair immune response needed for TB treatment effectiveness.
action: Monitor TB treatment response closely; consider alternative corticosteroid or increased pyrazinamide dosing; ensure adequate TB therapy efficacy with clinical and microbiological follow-up.
